title: The tape
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, foggy small American town, cold blue and amber tones, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 2. Thirty years later, someone finally watched the whole tape. 📼

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: in Harlow Creek, the one family who locked their doors vanished at 3:12 in the morning.
scenes.image: foggy small-town street at night, every front door ajar, porch lights glowing

scenes.narration: Thirty years later, a podcaster named Jenna Cole drove into town to find out why. Nobody would talk to her. But the sheriff let her into the evidence room.
scenes.image: young woman with a flashlight in a dusty small-town police evidence room, metal shelves of old boxes

scenes.narration: In a box marked Mercer, she found it. The camcorder tape from that night. The sign-out sheet was empty. Nobody had touched it since 1987.
scenes.image: close-up of an old VHS camcorder tape in a cardboard evidence box labeled with a faded tag, flashlight beam

scenes.narration: She watched it in her rented room. The hallway. The front door. The deadbolt turning on its own at 3:12. Everything the reports described.
scenes.image: woman's silhouette watching an old CRT television in a dark motel room, the screen showing a grainy hallway

scenes.narration: But the reports said the tape ended there. It didn't. There was one more minute.
scenes.image: grainy VHS frame of a dark hallway with a faint figure-shaped shadow at the far end

scenes.narration: Tom Mercer steps into frame. He's shaking. He looks straight into the lens and whispers: it doesn't need to knock. It already lives here.
scenes.image: grainy 1980s home video still of a frightened man in pajamas staring into the camera, dark hallway behind him

scenes.narration: Then the screen goes black. And on the tape, very faintly, Jenna hears her own street name. Alder Lane.
scenes.image: black television screen reflecting a woman's pale frightened face in a dark room

scenes.narration: That night she locked her door. She checked it twice. At 3:12, she heard the deadbolt turn.
scenes.image: close-up of a brass deadbolt on a motel room door slowly turning by itself in the dark, thin light under the door
a motel room door slowly swinging open into a black foggy night, nothing visible outside
